say:2:1610322001:2.source_cn: 啊啊啊对不起对不起对不起——！！！

say:3:1610322002:2.text: You see Pippa on her knees, flustered and at a complete loss, before a parrot that is flapping its wings, its tail feathers emitting faint wisps of smoke.
say:3:1610322002:2.source_cn: 你看见皮帕正手足无措地跪在一只鹦鹉面前，鹦鹉扑腾着翅膀...
say:3:1610322002:2.male: You see Pippa on her knees, flustered and at a complete loss, before a parrot that is flapping its wings, its tail feathers emitting faint wisps of smoke.
say:3:1610322002:2.female: You see Pippa on her knees, flustered and at a complete loss, before a parrot that is flapping its wings, its tail feathers emitting faint wisps of smoke.

say:4:1610322003:1.text: She lit him up... Burned this year's champion... Feather Race Champion.
say:4:1610322003:1.source_cn: 她点燃了它！她点燃了它！那是今年的羽毛比赛冠军！！

say:5:1610322004:1.text: Oh no! Without my beautiful tail feathers, how can I ever court a mate?
say:5:1610322004:1.source_cn: 没了漂亮的尾羽，我再也不能求偶了！

say:6:1610322005:1.text:
Please don't be angry! I have a spell to regenerate feathers.
Although last time I tried it, mushrooms appeared instead of feathers... I'm sure it will work this time!
say:6:1610322005:1.source_cn: 别生气，我可以用羽毛再生术。\n呃……虽然上次用的时候...

say:8:1610322006:3.text: You stop Pippa and help the parrot repair his burnt tail feathers.
say:8:1610322006:3.source_cn: 你阻止了皮帕，并帮助鹦鹉修复了烧焦的尾羽。
say:8:1610322006:3.male: You stop Pippa and help the parrot repair his burnt tail feathers.
say:8:1610322006:3.female: You stop Pippa and help the parrot repair his burnt tail feathers.

say:10:1610322007:0.text: My feathers! They're okay! Thank you so much!
say:10:1610322007:0.source_cn: 我的羽毛！太好了……谢谢你魔法师！
say:10:1610322007:0.male: My feathers! They're okay! Thank you so much!
say:10:1610322007:0.female: My feathers! They're okay! Thank you so much!

say:11:1610322008:1.text: Thank you for helping, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. This parrot broke some of his feathers in a panic, so I wanted to treat him, but it didn't go well.
say:11:1610322008:1.male: Thank you for helping, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. This parrot broke some of his feathers in a panic, so I wanted to treat him, but it didn't go well.
say:11:1610322008:1.female: Thank you for helping, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. This parrot broke some of his feathers in a panic, so I wanted to treat him, but it didn't go well.

say:12:1610322009:1.text: Actually, I just wanted to ask these animals if they had seen anything unusual...
say:12:1610322009:1.source_cn: 其实我本来只是想问问它们有没有看到什么不寻常的现象……
say:12:1610322009:1.male: Actually, I just wanted to ask these animals if they had seen anything unusual...
say:12:1610322009:1.female: Actually, I just wanted to ask these animals if they had seen anything unusual...

say:14:1610322010:1.text: Unusual? Those students... in the light... vanished... in a flash.
say:14:1610322010:1.source_cn: 不寻常，那些学生，在光里，咻地一下就不见了。

say:15:1610322011:1.text: In the light? Vanished in a flash?

say:16:1610322012:1.text: Yes, I saw it... where the round pattern... was on the ground.
say:16:1610322012:1.source_cn: 是的，我看见了，就在地上有圆圆图案的地方。

say:17:1610322013:1.text: He's talking about the plaza near Solstice Hall. I'll go and take a look.
say:17:1610322013:1.source_cn: 说的好像是日时礼堂的广场……我也去看看。
say:17:1610322013:1.male: He's talking about the plaza near Solstice Hall. I'll go and take a look.
say:17:1610322013:1.female: He's talking about the plaza near Solstice Hall. I'll go and take a look.
